rounds.prompt: How many times does the name "Harry" appear across all seven Harry Potter books?
rounds.source: UC Business Analytics R Programming Guide (University of Cincinnati), word-frequency analysis of the full text of all seven books: 'harry' appears 16,557 times

rounds.prompt: What is the combined age of all of the ambassadors to the United Nations?
rounds.source: UN Protocol list of permanent representatives in New York (as listed on Wikipedia, December 2025), with birth dates from Wikidata for the 58 who have one: average age 61

rounds.prompt: If everyone on Earth formed one giant human pyramid, with each row one person shorter than the row below, how many rows tall would it be?
rounds.source: United Nations World Population Prospects 2024, mid-2026 world population estimate
